persistentSessions.line: Every session is kept with its folder, its agent and its conversation.

recovery.line: After a freeze or a restart, Persisty relaunches what it can and says what it could not bring back.

projects.line: Work split by business project, with several workspaces in each.

agentStates.line: Which agent is working, which one is waiting for you and which one asks for permission.

board.line: Every project's agent sessions on one screen, with what each one asks and how long it has waited.

editorGit.line: Editor, git changes, commits, branches and notes without leaving the app.

gitHosting.line: GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket connected, with more than one account, and workspaces added from the repository.

usage.line: Each session's spend and context, and the live 5-hour and 7-day windows.
usage.where: Status bar and Settings › AI usage

notifications.line: An in-app notice, with sound, and a system notification when an agent needs you.

mascot.line: On macOS, the mascot stands on the window you are in and rises when a session needs you.
mascot.where: Settings › Appearance › Mascot outside the app

voice.line: Dictate into the terminal or the editor. The voice model runs on this computer.

trackers.line: Start a session from a Linear, Jira, ClickUp or GitHub issue and finish it there.
trackers.where: Settings › Integrations and Project settings › Tasks

agentTools.line: Claude Code sessions get tools that read the project, the other sessions and the tasks' output.

networkLog.line: Every network call the app makes shows up in a list.

noAccount.line: The core works without an account and without internet.
noAccount.where: From the first time you open it

issueToSession.line: A label on the issue opens the session on its branch, with the request queued.

bestOfN.line: The same request in 2 to 4 sessions, each in its own folder, so you keep the best one.

crossReview.line: Another agent reviews the changes and leaves its findings in the session.

accountRotation.line: New sessions go to the Claude Code account with the most room. One that reaches the limit you chose sits out.
accountRotation.where: Settings › AI accounts › Rotate between accounts

requestQueue.line: Write the next request now. It goes when the agent is free, when the 5-hour window renews or from a set time.

restorePoints.line: Each request saves the folder's state before the agent starts. Going back is one click.

verifyOnFinish.line: When the agent stops after changing files, your test command runs by itself.
verifyOnFinish.where: Workspace commands › Check on finish with…

worktrees.line: A branch and a folder for the session alone, so two agents never edit the same files.

offlineLicense.line: The app renews the license by itself when there is a connection. You see and remove each computer in My account.

remote.line: From your phone, with Persisty open on your computer: approve, deny or answer what is waiting for you, watch each session live, send requests and follow your accounts' quota. End-to-end encrypted.

autopilot.line: Per project, what the agent does alone, what stays blocked and what asks for you, with secrets masked.

nightShift.line: With Persisty open, requests use the quota your accounts have left and you get a summary.

sessionXray.line: Each session's timeline, with the cost per step, per task and per PR.

teamBilling.line: One bill with a seat per person, invites by e-mail and everything in Pro for each of them.
teamBilling.where: My account › Team, on the website

teamBoard.line: Who is running what right now, which agent is waiting for someone, and handing a session to a teammate.

budgets.line: A spend limit per project, a warning at 80%, the queue paused at the limit and the models each project may use.

observability.line: Cost per merged PR and per project, and how much of the work was accepted or abandoned. No individual productivity metric.

teamMemory.line: The team's conventions and decisions go into every session. What an agent learns becomes a suggestion to approve.

policies.line: Team rules for the agents and a record the agent cannot erase.
